body_lead: Kerala Industries Minister P Rajeev released a report prepared by a top bureaucrat on the controversial AI camera deal, which absolved the government of any wrongdoing, on Friday, May 19. The Minister dismissed the Congress-led opposition's allegation that it was a corrupt deal where a commission worth Rs 100 crore changed hands. But, a dissatisfied Congress is readying legal action. "All the tender process has been done according to guidelines, and the report has dismissed all the allegations levelled as baseless.
